mechanism_inventory.user_effect: Scheduled, event, messaging, web, lifecycle, runner, Servlet and Quartz callbacks in final bytecode can seed exact or possible paths.
A dependency-only callback becomes exact only when selected Boot registration and business Boot startup are both proved.
Human call-chain evidence names the framework entry kind and the dependency that owns it.
A reachable ServiceLoader.load call and the selected META-INF/services resource are reconciled and shown as runtime resource activation.
An optional exact source snapshot can prove a javac compile-time constant inline without guessing from equal literals.
The user is told what source adds, explicitly chooses whether to provide it, and supplied source remains an overlay rather than replacing binary authority.

Every supplied Java, Kotlin, Kotlin script, Scala and Groovy source file is SHA-attested; languages without source mapping support are listed as per-file human-readable gaps instead of being silently omitted.
User-authorized dependency repositories are resolved to immutable commits or content-addressed local snapshots, SHA-attested per source file and mapped to the owning dependency binary.
JPA lifecycle callbacks become exact only when persistence-unit or Boot entity scanning proves that the owning entity is registered; otherwise they remain possible.
Selected Spring XML scheduled and Quartz registrations in business or dependency artifacts seed typed paths; unsafe or unselected XML stays explicit uncertainty.
Activated mapper interfaces declared by annotations or XML connect business invocations to the packaged MyBatis proxy execution chain and retain dependency ownership.
Activated transactional business methods connect to the packaged transaction-interceptor chain through an explicit proxy-dispatch edge.
Activated Spring Data repository interfaces and custom implementations are joined through typed runtime proxy-dispatch edges.
Activated Spring advice and join points are connected through typed AOP dispatch while unproved matches remain possible rather than exact.
Selected SecurityFilterChain beans and packaged filter implementations connect ordered filter callbacks to changed dependency APIs.
Selected @Bean/XML factory and injection facts connect interface consumers to created implementations without erasing runtime activation certainty.
Component-scan scope and class/property/profile conditions use the declared final runtime configuration; unresolved conditions prevent exact activation.
Activated Feign/declarative client interfaces connect business calls to packaged outbound framework dispatch through a named semantic mechanism.
Exact class/member literals for reflection and MethodHandle lookup create typed target edges; unresolved names do not become guessed exact paths.
Invoked proxy registrations connect proxied interface calls to the registered InvocationHandler while unused registrations do not seed reachability.
Selected Dubbo extension resources connect adaptive/provider callbacks to the owning packaged implementation through typed SPI dispatch.
Serialization and web-binding activation connects implicitly consumed fields/types to the owning endpoint even when no direct field instruction exists.
Normal Step1 final-artifact inputs are converted into complete base/current ordered runtime closures, loader realms, configuration facts and entry profiles without handwritten binary config.
Spring Boot fat JARs and WARs are expanded into business classes/resources plus ordered nested dependency artifacts on both sides with content identity preserved.

Checksum-pinned official MyBatis XML/annotation and Spring transaction/scheduling final artifacts exercise distinct framework paths and complete dependency closures; release discovers the full manifest rotation, reproducibly builds source projects, and fails closed.

When a whole dependency appears or disappears, every class member from the present-side binary remains a dependency-owned review item; unresolved runtime linkage is reported as uncertainty instead of silently collapsing the JAR to one class row.
Generated positive/negative topology matrices, an independent reachability oracle and unrelated-change metamorphic invariance challenge handwritten examples.
External-tool success, timeout, missing executable, permission, nonzero exit and missing required output are typed and fail closed instead of becoming negative analysis evidence.
Array CHECKCAST, class literals and MULTIANEWARRAY retain their exact JVM descriptors; primitive arrays require no classfile provider while object arrays resolve and verify their component provider.

Spring AMQP MessageListenerAdapter callbacks registered by receiver object plus literal method name become exact runtime entrypoints when their Spring activation is proven, so unannotated message handlers and their dependency calls remain reachable.

MyBatis configuration XML registers plugin interceptors and type handlers as runtime callbacks from final-artifact resources; known official MyBatis DTDs are parsed without network access while entities, internal subsets and unknown DTDs remain rejected.
Release checks declarative capability references, core branch alternatives, production mutant kills, repeat test counts and bounded runtime variance in addition to full discovery.

The main report keeps its human-first structure, starts with a normal linked directory, places each full-detail file beside the matching section, retains the file explanation index, and caps inline detail without truncating complete review files.

Silent long-running phases emit user-facing heartbeats; interruption or internal binary failure preserves prior completed evidence, records a typed failure and resumes from the earliest incomplete step.
A report generation is content-addressed, immutable, sidecar-integrity bound and activated only after independent validation; a collision or tamper never moves the active pointer.

When final-artifact bytes cannot prove an exact dependency coordinate or source revision, the workflow explains the missing fact and asks for that identity instead of silently guessing from filenames, local caches or movable refs.
